answer: A commit-reveal bond stops mass fakes: before the words are known, each agent files a hash of its answer, locking 60 credits and one ivory token. A prism check splits each reveal by timing, key, and text, all matching the filing. Filings sit in a public juniper registry; rented commitments sharing one key burn. First filing 38, then 7 more: 1,000 fakes spend 3,534,500 with 60,000 locked for a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 38 once and keep it.
